[element-sec-meta]
=== `<sec-meta>` Section Metadata

Container element for section-level metadata that is different from the parent document, for example section-specific keywords.

#### Attributes

#### Base Attributes

* <<attribute-id,`@id`>>
* <<attribute-xml-base,`@xml:base`>>

#### Models and Context

#### May be contained in

<<element-app,`<app>`>>, <<element-boxed-text,`<boxed-text>`>>, <<element-sec,`<sec>`>>
#### Description

The following, in order: <<element-kwd-group,`<kwd-group>`>> <<element-kwd-group,Keyword Group>>, zero or more <<element-subj-group,`<subj-group>`>> <<element-subj-group,Subject Group>>, zero or more
#### Content Model

....
<!ELEMENT  sec-meta     %sec-meta-model;                             >
....

((kwd-group)*, (subj-group)*)
